newsitem.title: UKRAINE: SOCCER-UKRAINE NOT TREATING ALBANIA LIGHTLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UKRAINE NOT TREATING ALBANIA LIGHTLY.

text.p: Ukraine face an under-strength Albania in a World Cup qualifying group nine match next Wednesday, but the group leaders were taking nothing for granted on Friday.

"There are no weak competitors in the world competitions. We don't want to make any prognosis or say that someone is an easy side to beat," Volodymyr Troshkin, Ukraine's Football Federation vice-president, told Reuters.
"Once we were too confident and could not beat Armenia," he added, referring to a disappointing 1-1 draw suffered by the Ukrainians in May in Kiev.
"For us, this is going to be a crucial game," Troshkin added. "We desperately need victory."
Ukraine beat Albania 1-0 in March, which was played in the Spanish city of Granada because of civil unrest in the Balkan country.
Albania are bottom of the group with just one point from six matches while Ukraine top the standings with 14 points from eight.
Ukraine have called up forward Ivan Getsko from Dnipro Dnipropetrovsk into their squad.
Goalkeepers - Olexander Shovkovsky, Illya Blyznyuk, Oleh Suslov;
Defenders - Oleh Luzhny, Serhiy Bezhenar, Olexander Golovko, Vladyslav Vashchuk, Olexander Koval, Yuri Dmytrulin;
Midfielders - Yuri Kalitvintsev, Dmytro Mykhailenko, Vitaly Kosovsky, Dmytro Mykhailenko, Hennady Zubov, Valery Kryventsov, Serhiy Kovalyov, Andriy Gusin;
Forwards - Andriy Shevchenko, Serhiy Rebrov, Serhiy Nahornyak, Ivan Getsko.
